```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE)
```

## 1. Install packages (run once, manually)

Install `worldfootballR` from GitHub, because the CRAN version is outdated.

```{r install, eval=FALSE}
install.packages(c("devtools", "dplyr", "tidyr", "ggplot2"))
devtools::install_github("JaseZiv/worldfootballR")
```

## 2. Load libraries

```{r libraries}
library(worldfootballR)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(ggplot2)
```

## 3. Settings

Understat league names: `"EPL"`, `"La liga"`, `"Bundesliga"`, `"Serie A"`,
`"Ligue 1"`, `"RFPL"`.

Seasons are given by their **start year**: `2021` = 2021/22, `2025` = 2025/26,
`2026` = 2026/27. A season that doesn't exist yet, or fails to download, is
skipped and reported rather than stopping the run.

```{r settings}
leagues            <- c("EPL")                 # add more, e.g. c("EPL", "La liga")
season_start_years <- 2021:2026                # 2021/22 ... 2026/27
refresh            <- FALSE                    # TRUE = ignore cache, re-download
pause_seconds      <- 3                        # be polite to Understat
cache_dir          <- "understat_cache"
```

## 4. Helpers

```{r helpers}
ensure_cols <- function(df, cols) {
  miss <- setdiff(cols, names(df))
  if (length(miss)) df[miss] <- NA
  df
}

season_label <- function(start) paste0(start, "/", substr(start + 1, 3, 4))
```

## 5. Download

Each league-season is saved to `cache_dir`, so re-running or knitting only
downloads what is missing.

```{r download}
dir.create(cache_dir, showWarnings = FALSE)

jobs     <- expand.grid(lg = leagues, yr = season_start_years, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
results  <- vector("list", nrow(jobs))
failures <- character()

for (i in seq_len(nrow(jobs))) {
  lg <- jobs$lg[i]; yr <- jobs$yr[i]
  label <- paste(lg, season_label(yr))
  f <- file.path(cache_dir, sprintf("shots_%s_%s.rds", gsub(" ", "_", lg), yr))

  if (file.exists(f) && !refresh) {
    results[[i]] <- readRDS(f)
    next
  }

  message(sprintf("[%d/%d] %s", i, nrow(jobs), label))
  res <- tryCatch({
    d <- understat_league_season_shots(league = lg, season_start_year = yr)
    if (is.null(d) || nrow(d) == 0) stop("no rows returned")
    d$league_name  <- lg
    d$season_start <- yr
    d
  }, error = function(e) {
    message("  FAILED: ", conditionMessage(e))
    NULL
  })

  if (is.null(res)) {
    failures <- c(failures, label)
  } else {
    saveRDS(res, f)
    results[[i]] <- res
  }
  Sys.sleep(pause_seconds)
}

raw <- bind_rows(results)

cat("Raw shots:", nrow(raw), "\n")
if (length(failures)) cat("Not available / failed:", paste(failures, collapse = ", "), "\n")
```

## 6. Clean and add features

Understat gives pitch coordinates as fractions from 0 to 1 (`X` runs towards the
goal being attacked). Below they're converted to two scales: a StatsBomb-style
120 x 80 pitch (`x`, `y`) and approximate metres on a 105 x 68 pitch
(`x_m`, `y_m`), which is used for distance and angle.

```{r clean}
raw_cols <- c("id", "minute", "result", "X", "Y", "xG", "player", "h_a",
              "player_id", "situation", "shotType", "match_id", "h_team",
              "a_team", "h_goals", "a_goals", "date", "player_assisted",
              "lastAction")

shots <- raw %>%
  ensure_cols(raw_cols) %>%
  transmute(
    league       = league_name,
    season_start,
    season       = season_label(season_start),
    match_id     = as.character(match_id),
    shot_id      = as.character(id),
    date         = as.Date(substr(as.character(date), 1, 10)),
    home_team    = h_team,
    away_team    = a_team,
    final_home_goals = as.integer(h_goals),
    final_away_goals = as.integer(a_goals),
    is_home      = h_a == "h",
    team         = if_else(h_a == "h", h_team, a_team),
    opponent     = if_else(h_a == "h", a_team, h_team),
    player,
    player_id    = as.character(player_id),
    assisted_by  = player_assisted,
    minute       = as.numeric(minute),
    xg           = as.numeric(xG),
    result,
    situation,
    shot_type    = shotType,
    last_action  = lastAction,
    X = as.numeric(X), Y = as.numeric(Y)
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    # coordinates on a StatsBomb-style 120 x 80 pitch
    x = X * 120,
    y = Y * 80,
    # approximate metres on a 105 x 68 pitch
    x_m = X * 105,
    y_m = Y * 68,
    distance_m = sqrt((105 - x_m)^2 + (34 - y_m)^2),
    angle_to_goal = abs(atan2(34 + 3.66 - y_m, 105 - x_m) -
                        atan2(34 - 3.66 - y_m, 105 - x_m)),
    # flags
    is_goal       = result == "Goal",
    is_own_goal   = result == "OwnGoal",
    on_target     = result %in% c("Goal", "SavedShot"),
    blocked       = result == "BlockedShot",
    hit_post      = result == "ShotOnPost",
    is_penalty    = situation == "Penalty",
    is_open_play  = situation == "OpenPlay",
    is_set_piece  = situation %in% c("SetPiece", "DirectFreekick", "FromCorner"),
    from_corner   = situation == "FromCorner",
    is_free_kick  = situation == "DirectFreekick",
    is_header     = shot_type == "Head",
    is_assisted   = !is.na(assisted_by)
  ) %>%
  select(-X, -Y)

# Score before each shot (counts goals scored in earlier minutes; own goals are
# not counted, and shots in the same minute as a goal ignore that goal).
goals <- shots %>%
  filter(is_goal) %>%
  select(match_id, goal_team = team, goal_minute = minute)

game_state <- shots %>%
  select(shot_id, match_id, team, minute) %>%
  left_join(goals, by = "match_id", relationship = "many-to-many") %>%
  group_by(shot_id) %>%
  summarise(
    team_goals_before = sum(goal_team == team & goal_minute < minute, na.rm = TRUE),
    opp_goals_before  = sum(goal_team != team & goal_minute < minute, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

shots <- shots %>%
  left_join(game_state, by = "shot_id") %>%
  mutate(
    score_diff = team_goals_before - opp_goals_before,
    game_state = case_when(score_diff > 0 ~ "Leading",
                           score_diff < 0 ~ "Trailing",
                           TRUE ~ "Level")
  )

glimpse(shots)
```

### Features available

| Group | Columns |
|---|---|
| Match | `league`, `season`, `match_id`, `date`, `home_team`, `away_team`, `final_home_goals`, `final_away_goals` |
| Team / player | `team`, `opponent`, `is_home`, `player`, `player_id`, `assisted_by` |
| Shot | `minute`, `xg`, `result`, `situation`, `shot_type`, `last_action` |
| Location | `x`, `y` (120 x 80), `x_m`, `y_m` (metres), `distance_m`, `angle_to_goal` |
| Flags | `is_goal`, `is_own_goal`, `on_target`, `blocked`, `hit_post`, `is_penalty`, `is_open_play`, `is_set_piece`, `from_corner`, `is_free_kick`, `is_header`, `is_assisted` |
| Game state | `team_goals_before`, `opp_goals_before`, `score_diff`, `game_state` |

## 7. Summaries

By league and season:

```{r by-season}
shots %>%
  filter(!is_own_goal) %>%
  group_by(league, season) %>%
  summarise(
    matches = n_distinct(match_id),
    shots   = n(),
    goals   = sum(is_goal),
    xg      = round(sum(xg, na.rm = TRUE), 1),
    goals_minus_xg = round(goals - xg, 1),
    shots_per_match = round(shots / matches, 1),
    .groups = "drop"
  )
```

Team xG for and against, per season:

```{r team-table}
xg_for <- shots %>%
  filter(!is_own_goal) %>%
  group_by(league, season, team) %>%
  summarise(matches = n_distinct(match_id), shots = n(),
            goals_for = sum(is_goal), xg_for = sum(xg, na.rm = TRUE),
            .groups = "drop")

xg_against <- shots %>%
  filter(!is_own_goal) %>%
  group_by(league, season, team = opponent) %>%
  summarise(shots_against = n(), goals_against = sum(is_goal),
            xg_against = sum(xg, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")

team_table <- xg_for %>%
  left_join(xg_against, by = c("league", "season", "team")) %>%
  mutate(xg_diff = round(xg_for - xg_against, 1),
         xg_for = round(xg_for, 1), xg_against = round(xg_against, 1)) %>%
  arrange(league, season, desc(xg_diff))

team_table
```

Top players by non-penalty xG (minimum 50 shots):

```{r top-players}
shots %>%
  filter(!is_own_goal, !is_penalty) %>%
  group_by(player, player_id) %>%
  summarise(shots = n(), goals = sum(is_goal),
            npxg = round(sum(xg, na.rm = TRUE), 1),
            npxg_per_shot = round(npxg / shots, 3), .groups = "drop") %>%
  filter(shots >= 50) %>%
  arrange(desc(npxg)) %>%
  head(20)
```

Shot situations:

```{r situations}
shots %>%
  filter(!is_own_goal) %>%
  group_by(situation) %>%
  summarise(shots = n(), goals = sum(is_goal),
            avg_xg = round(mean(xg, na.rm = TRUE), 3),
            conversion = round(mean(is_goal), 3), .groups = "drop") %>%
  arrange(desc(shots))
```

## 8. Plots

xG vs distance, with the actual goal rate (dots):

```{r xg-distance, fig.width=8, fig.height=4.5}
shots %>%
  filter(!is_own_goal, !is_penalty, distance_m <= 40) %>%
  mutate(dist_bin = cut(distance_m, breaks = seq(0, 40, 2.5), include.lowest = TRUE)) %>%
  group_by(dist_bin) %>%
  summarise(mean_xg = mean(xg, na.rm = TRUE), goal_rate = mean(is_goal),
            n = n(), .groups = "drop") %>%
  ggplot(aes(dist_bin)) +
  geom_col(aes(y = mean_xg), fill = "steelblue", alpha = 0.7) +
  geom_point(aes(y = goal_rate), colour = "red", size = 2) +
  labs(x = "Distance to goal (m)", y = "Mean xG (bars) / goal rate (dots)",
       title = "xG vs distance") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))
```

Shot locations:

```{r shot-density, fig.width=8, fig.height=5.5}
shots %>%
  filter(!is_own_goal, !is_penalty, x >= 60) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x, y)) +
  geom_bin2d(binwidth = c(2, 2)) +
  scale_fill_viridis_c(option = "magma", trans = "sqrt", name = "Shots") +
  annotate("rect", xmin = 102, xmax = 120, ymin = 18, ymax = 62, fill = NA, colour = "white") +
  annotate("rect", xmin = 114, xmax = 120, ymin = 30, ymax = 50, fill = NA, colour = "white") +
  coord_fixed(xlim = c(60, 120), ylim = c(0, 80)) +
  scale_y_reverse() +
  labs(title = "Shot locations", x = NULL, y = NULL) +
  theme_minimal()
```

Goals minus xG by team, most recent season in the data:

```{r over-under, fig.width=8, fig.height=6}
latest <- max(team_table$season)
team_table %>%
  filter(season == latest) %>%
  mutate(over_under = goals_for - xg_for,
         team = reorder(team, over_under)) %>%
  ggplot(aes(team, over_under, fill = over_under > 0)) +
  geom_col(show.legend = FALSE) +
  coord_flip() +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("firebrick", "seagreen")) +
  labs(title = paste("Goals minus xG,", latest), x = NULL, y = "Goals - xG") +
  theme_minimal()
```

## 9. Save

```{r save}
write.csv(shots, "understat_shots.csv", row.names = FALSE)
saveRDS(shots, "understat_shots.rds")
```

## Optional: faster pre-scraped data

`worldfootballR` also hosts pre-scraped Understat shots, which load in seconds
but may lag behind the live site. Run this by hand if scraping is slow, then
assign the result to `raw` and re-run the cleaning chunk onwards.

```{r prescraped, eval=FALSE}
raw <- load_understat_league_shots(league = "EPL") %>%
  mutate(league_name  = "EPL",
         season_start = as.integer(season)) %>%
  filter(season_start %in% season_start_years)
```
